We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives. This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey. It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life. What is the Role? This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants. This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient.

In this high-impact team, you will gain substantial senior leadership exposure and the opportunity to drive long-term customer and shareholder value at a high-growth company.

As the Product Marketing Manager for Toast Embedded Finance , you will help shape the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for a fast-growing portfolio of financial products, including Toast Capital, designed to help businesses take control of their cash flow. You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams to bring new offerings to market, support cross-product launch strategies, and build messaging that positions Toast Capital (and other fintech products/services) as a key differentiator in competitive deals. You will lead and contribute to initiatives spanning product positioning, customer research, campaign planning, and sales enablement, with a focus on driving awareness, adoption, and retention across the full lifecycle. The ideal candidate has experience launching and scaling products, leading cross-functional initiatives, and using insights to inform both near-term tactics and long-term strategy in a dynamic, customer-first environment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities):

• Lead go-to-market strategy, launch processes, and stakeholder management, and influence product development and positioning for new embedded fintech products and features

• Advocate as the voice of our customer, and partner with Product and Customer Marketing to develop key initiatives that drive efficient product adoption

• Become a market and industry expert on key financial products, and use customer and market research to inform both product and GTM strategy

• Take ownership of conversion and adoption metrics and GTM performance, and implement cross-functional plans to drive improvements

• Collaborate with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success to drive sales productivity through product knowledge transfer, seller collateral, and value-based talk tracks
